chapterTitle: Chapter 21 Carboxylic Acid Derivatives: Nucleophilic Acyl Substitution Reactions
title: Problem 21-6

pages.text: PROBLEM 21-6 The following structure represents a tetrahedral alkoxide ion intermediate formed by addition of a nucleophile to a carboxylic acid derivative. Identify the nucleophile, the leaving group, the starting acid derivative, and the ultimate product.
